fusions.name: Scent Trail
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt that deals 9 damage and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Its damage rises 10% per affliction on the target (max 40%). It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Circling Rush
fusions.desc: You rush to the target and strike every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 13 damage and making them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Blood in the Water
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Lurking Strike
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your next strike has 40% more critical chance.
